412.skilldes: Charges natural energy with a bow, then fires 1 hawk spirit(s). The first and final hit of the whirlwind have a <color=#ed9053>30%</color> chance to pull hit enemies toward the center of the whirlwind.

The first and final hit of the whirlwind have a <color=#ed9053>53.2%</color> chance to pull hit enemies toward the center of the whirlwind.
